**Limitations**

- scikit-image notes that the box filters are not accurate below sigma 3.
- On the Disks image, the centers come out one or two pixels up and to the left of the true ones.
- Blobs larger than the largest sigma are found in the wrong place. With the defaults, the disk of radius 48 on the Disks image is found 27 pixels from its center.
- The boxes do not always sum to zero, and they are clipped at the image edge. So even a flat gray image can give a false blob at a large scale.
- It cannot tell bright blobs from dark ones.

**Artifacts**

- Square-looking responses, from the box filters.
